fences.rule: If the missing witness kills the fact, so that no difference leaves a trace at all, it is there; if the fact stands, both principals believe it, and only the closing form refuses belief, the death is here.
fences.case: A business sale that needs audited accounts from a seller who never kept auditable books.

fences.rule: If a fiction, an instrument, or an invented principal can be minted that lets the deal close, it is a chip there; if no fiction can be minted, or the ratifier is real with a want of its own, the death is here.
fences.case: The escrow or specific indemnity that takes the written contamination finding off the price and lets the deal close.

fences.rule: If the delay is latency summed across the refusal rights of coalition members, it is the veto queue there; if a single signer who is not a party gains nothing by consenting and is blamed if it goes wrong, the death is here.
fences.case: A landlord asked to consent to a lease assignment, whose best move is silence on no clock.
